key.name: detached
key.description: If true, shows as separate component with gap. If false, integrates directly into Quick Settings.

key.name: position
key.description: Position of the image banner (top or bottom of Quick Settings)

key.name: gap
key.description: Gap in pixels when in detached mode

key.name: image-path
key.description: Full path to the image file to display

key.name: hover-images-enabled
key.description: Enable multiple images that change on mouse hover

key.name: hover-images
key.description: Comma-separated list of image paths for hover effect

key.name: image-width
key.description: Width of the displayed image in pixels (-1 = full Quick Settings width)

key.name: image-height
key.description: Height of the banner in pixels (0 = auto height based on image aspect ratio)

key.name: script-path
key.description: Path to script that executes when image is clicked
